workflow.name: Scrape a site to Markdown (Firecrawl)
workflow.description: Scrapes a URL with Firecrawl, saves the Markdown to Artifacts and writes a short summary.

nodes.label: Scrape with Firecrawl
nodes.prompt:
Scrape {{inputs.url}} with the Firecrawl API.

1. POST https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1/scrape with `Authorization: Bearer $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`, JSON {"url":"{{inputs.url}}","formats":["markdown"]}. Use curl; never print the key.
2. Save data.markdown to "$ARTIFACTS_DIR/page.md".
3. Reply with a 5-bullet summary of the page and the saved path.

If FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is not set, stop and say: add FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in Hive › Keys.
